informal_restatement.author: formal-conjectures 文档注释（原文）
informal_restatement.text: For every positive real number `ε`, there exist only finitely many triples `(a, b, c)` of coprime positive integers, with `a + b = c`, such that `c > rad(abc)^(1+ε)`
